role: Renders an EntityChicken: the chicken model whose wing angle comes from handleRotationFloat's (sin(wingPos) + 1) * wingSpread interpolation.
scope_reason: Chickens are in the gated animal spawn lists and the mob scenes compare their pixels.

members.name: doRender
members.note: model_chicken builds head, body, legs and wings; the wing angle arrives as the dump's wing field (e->wing)

members.name: handleRotationFloat
members.note: the (sin(wingPos) + 1) * wingSpread formula runs on the oracle side and is recorded as the wing field the native consumes; the C code does not recompute it

notes: handleRotationFloat's arithmetic lives in the oracle dump (frames.jsonl wing) rather than in C; the render scenes still gate the resulting pixels exactly. This follows the render pipeline's recorded-scene contract: the pose inputs are state the frame reads, not per-frame RNG.
